title: Seagrove Beach "Drift Away 30A" 57 Azalea Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf-front - 6-passenger Low Speed Vehicle - Large Rooftop Deck with Gulf Views– Approximately 250 Steps to Beach- Game room -Private resort style pool and sitting spa *Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $70 per day-Complimentary beach setups provided each morning include 6 beach chairs and 3 umbrellas (service provided March 1-October 31) - Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity - Elevator - Garage- 8 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Dream vacations come to life at Drift Away 30A, an immaculate Seagrove Beach home sleeping 28 guests in exceptional comfort. With 8 beautiful bedrooms, 8.5 bathrooms, and multiple spaces for relaxation and recreation, this 3-story retreat perfectly pairs entertainment and elegance. Take in panoramic Gulf views and pastel sunsets from the expansive rooftop deck, indulge in sun-soaked days beside the resort-style pool, or stroll to the beach—only a 2-minute walk away!Pool tournaments, tasty cocktails, and leisurely days await on the first level, where a game room with a wet bar and pool table leads to the enclosed backyard. A sparkling pool, cushioned loungers, and an outdoor kitchen, complete with a bar and alfresco dining table, offer the ultimate setting for unwinding. Back inside, a dedicated laundry room offers convenience and charming sleeping accommodations—a bunk room featuring 3 queen-over-queen bunks and a guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom—invite peaceful rest.An in-home elevator whisks guests to the second-level great room, adorned with a stylish plank-wood ceiling, hardwood floors, and cascades of natural light. A vast marble island takes center stage in the gourmet kitchen, equipped with premium appliances for elevated culinary creation. Enjoy dinner at the live-edge dining table, which seats 10 beneath a modern gold chandelier, with extra seating for 4 at the breakfast bar. The covered deck, featuring an alfresco table for 6 and soft seating, beckons for tranquil mornings sipping coffee in the overhead fan’s gentle breeze. End a laughter-filled day with a movie night gathered on the soft sectional in the living space. The luxurious primary bedroom features a plush king bed, a family-friendly twin-over-twin bunk bed, and a private bathroom.An extra living space with a TV, couch, and armchairs welcomes guests onto the third level, along with 1 primary and 3 guest bedrooms featuring king beds, and 1 guest bedroom with 2 twin beds. All the bedrooms on this level have a private bathroom.Venture up to the furnished rooftop deck to soak up the Gulf view and golden sunshine.Discover exceptional comfort and delightful luxuries at Drift Away 30A in Seagrove Beach. With on-site garage parking—plus 8 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle—it’s easy to explore. For beach access, stroll down Azalea Street, turn left on East County Highway 30A, and use the Azalea-Camelia access across the street. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 28):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Bunk Room: 3 Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom, King Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Soaking TubTHIRD FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bath with Shower and Soaking Tub-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
